sortie.speaker: tower
lines: Viper One, cleared for takeoff. Good hunting.
Runway is yours, Viper. Wheels up and get on them.
Fresh jet on the line, Viper. You're cleared hot.

rearmed.speaker: tower
lines: Rearmed and refuelled. Get back out there.
Ground crew's done, Viper. You're good to go.

waveInbound.speaker: tower
lines: Tower to Viper, new contacts crossing the valley.
Heads up, armour moving on the airfield.
Here they come again. Multiple vehicles, east of the river.

waveClear.speaker: tower
lines: That's the last of them. Stand by for the next push.
Scope is clean. Catch your breath, Viper.

missionComplete.speaker: tower
lines: Mission complete. Bring her home, Viper.
That's it, they're breaking off. Outstanding flying.

baseHit.speaker: tower
lines: Tower is taking fire! We need support at the field.
Rounds landing on the airfield. Get them off us!

baseCritical.speaker: tower
lines: The airfield is burning, Viper. We can't hold much longer.
Tower to all aircraft, the field is about to fall!

playerDown.speaker: tower
lines: Viper is down! Get a fresh jet on the line.
We lost Viper One. Spinning up a replacement.

lastAircraft.speaker: tower
lines: That's our last airframe, Viper. Make it count.

enemyAir.speaker: wingman
lines: Fast movers on the scope, watch your six.
Enemy aircraft in the area, heads on a swivel.

enemyLock.speaker: wingman
lines: They've got a lock on you, get low!
SAM radar on you, Viper. Move!

streak.speaker: wingman
lines: Good effect on target! Keep it coming.

wingCover.speaker: wingman
lines: Forming up. I've got your six.

wingRearm.speaker: wingman
lines: Copy, Two RTB for fuel and missiles.

wingBack.speaker: wingman
lines: Two is airborne. Rejoining the fight.

wingmanDown.speaker: wingman
lines: Mayday, mayday, Two is hit, ejecting!
Mayday! Two's going down, I'm punching out!
Viper Two is hit and out of the fight.
